{{Top|leg}}
'''Neurix tubes''' were components used in [[B'omarr brain walker]]s. These retractable tubes were located in the housing that connected the [[glassine]] [[Brain/Legends|brain]] jar of the [[B'omarr Order/Legends|B'omarr]] [[Monk/Legends|monk]] to the [[Spider/Legends|spider]]-like walker.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> When extended, they would descend from the housing into the [[nutrient fluid]] surrounding the disembodied brain.<ref>''[[Star Wars: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>
